page.overview:
What is River to the Seas?

River to the Seas is a one-time location in World of Final Fantasy, visited during the events of Chapter 9, "The Low Seas".

There are no items to collect or any enemies to be fought, yet the player can take control of the lead character for a short time on the top of the fastcraft. Once the following field dialogue and cutscenes play out, and the player makes it down to The Low Seas, this area cannot be visited again.
